$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Sessions and Phone access settings: what this Mac does while agents work and for your phone. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (both lists parse into SessionSettings). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: sessions
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Sessions: this Mac's behavior while agent sessions run (SessionSettings).

rows.note: Idle system sleep stays off while a local agent works (KeepAwakeService). The display can still sleep, and closing the lid still sleeps the Mac.

title.text: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work

help.text: Stops idle sleep while an agent on this Mac is working. Your display can still turn off, and closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

choices.note: The Mac sleeps on its usual schedule.
Only while the Mac runs on power from an adapter.

rows.name: allowFullAccess
rows.note: Off: AgentPaneTransport refuses session/set_mode and the mode config option into a mode that skips approvals (AgentPaneModeConfirmation.isFullAccess, the picker's warning-color rule). On by default: today's behavior, and Lawrence 2026-10-07 (no sheet for full access).

help.text: Modes like bypass permissions, full access or yolo let an agent run commands and change files without asking, which can lose data or leak it through a prompt injection. Off, cmux won't switch an agent into them. On by default.

rows.name: promptSuggestions
rows.note: Agents get the cmux-sessions MCP tools (ACPMUX_OFFER_TOOLS=1, read at each acpmux daemon start) and the pages show their suggested tasks (AgentPaneSuggestedTasks). The Debug Settings toggle agent.suggestedTasks still turns it on. Off by default, as the tunable was.

help.text: Agents can suggest next tasks, which you start as child chats beside the current one. Agents started after the change get it.

lists.name: phone
lists.note: Settings > Accounts > Phone Access: whether phones signed in to your cmux account reach this Mac and what they may do (PhoneAccessGate, MobileHostService). The transport (Iroh today) is not part of any key.

rows.name: allowConnections
rows.note: Off: the phone listener does not run and no phone reaches this Mac. Off on a fresh install; a Mac that already served phones keeps it on (PhoneAccessMigration).

title.text: Let Your Phone Use This Mac

help.text: cmux registers this Mac's name, platform, app version and relay address with your cmux account so your phone can find it. Workspace names, folders, full paths and terminal output go only over the encrypted link to your phone. None of that, and no branch name or repo URL, is sent to cmux servers.

rows.name: startSessions
rows.note: Off: phones may view, type into and answer existing workspaces and agents, but not create workspaces or terminals (compat RPC and daemon lanes alike).

title.text: Let Your Phone Start New Workspaces

help.text: Off, your phone can still follow, type into and answer what's already running.

rows.name: phoneKeepAwake
rows.note: Idle system sleep stays off while phone access is on and the listener runs (KeepAwakeService). A sleeping Mac is unreachable until it wakes.

title.text: Keep Mac Awake for Your Phone

help.text: A sleeping Mac can't be reached from your phone until it wakes. Closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

choices.note: The Mac sleeps on its usual schedule.
Only while the Mac runs on power from an adapter.
